notes.title: BUILD NOTES V0.5.50
notes.content:
Demo candidate build

[list]
[*] New combat tutorial
[*] Revamped Spike to only last for the turn, and updated Spike-related Perks
[*] Change Spike Storm to apply Bleed and then damage enemies
[*] Improved Upgrade UI to better show what an action will become
[*] General bug fix and polish
[/list]

notes.title: BUILD NOTES V0.5.45
notes.content:
[list]
[*]  Altered Boss minion intro cutscene and demo now ends before the fight (we'll add the fight when we've reworked it)
[*]  Bleed no longer pre-adds to attack intentions
[*]  Nerf rooster and chicken a little
[*]  Possum gives additional tile types
[*]  Bilby may make an appearance again
[*]  Fix for Epic perks sometimes appearing in common pools
[*]  Fix Brawler behaviour on rat, was buffing all characters
[*]  Fixes for Multi-action displaying on tiles
[/list]

notes.title: BUILD NOTES v0.5.44
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A few new actions
[*] New art for some missing icons
[*] New combat tutorial with objectives
[*] Boss minions and Honey Badger have more health. 
[*] Boss minions have had a full revision of their behaviours, with more fixes to come.
[*] Reduced Winnie's starting max health to add more tension and higher stakes.
[/list]

KNOWN ISSUEs:
[list]
[*] Sometimes the combat tutorial won't trigger and you don't get your full action deck. Exiting the run and playing again should fix this, and it only happens when you play the tutorial.
[*] Missing icons for some of Boss minion behaviours.
[*] Repeating Strike and Repeating Shield don't list they happen 2x in the selection UI or deck 
[/list]

notes.title: BUILD NOTES V0.5.43
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New Multiply action type, similar to Bonus but Multiplies the amount! Combo time!
[*] Art updates for missing Perks and enemies
[*] Intro cutscene character art update
[*] General rebalance of level generation - fewer evolutions, more growth areas and single tile pickups
[/list]

notes.title: BUILD NOTES V0.5.42
notes.content:
For some previous build notes, [url=https://discord.gg/twicedifferent]join our Discord.[/url]

I'm going to start posting Build Notes here as well.

[list]
[*] New combat tutorial. Rework of the Bandicoot section, now with some narrative development and a bit more guidance for those who may need it
[*] Shield now appears as an icon on health bars
[*] Brain Grow is back in after Honey Badger
[*] More single tile blocks will be in exploration
[*] Honey Badger and enemies beyond have had a bit of a health reduction, and some tile rework for ones which gave Self-Damage
[*] Buff Stun to 2 turns instead of 1
[*] Lots of bug fix!
[/list]
